svg.aria-label: Sketchbook page 3, drawn in crayon. Apna Saathi. Fully offline on a Jetson Orin Nano Super. Speech in 9 languages goes through speech recognition, a safety check that routes emergencies to 108, an answer from local documents first, and a spoken reply, in about 2.7 seconds for a typical Hindi query.
